readerCopy.body: An old hurt can make a new opportunity look dangerous for reasons that belong partly to what happened before. When Chiron squares the North Node, sensitivity and forward movement create friction, bringing criticism, visibility, asking for help, or trying again into contact with an earlier experience that still carries authority. The fear may contain useful information about what needs protection now. A better boundary or support can address that information without making permanent avoidance the only safe option.
